notes.title: Long-haired women framing the text
notes.text: Two long-haired female figures flank the central rectangular text panel. Their faces are visible near the top; sweeping curved lines connect the upper decoration, and further loops appear below the panel. The composition has a broadly bilateral arrangement. This observation does not establish exact pixel reflection, identify the figures, or attribute a source artwork.

notes.title: Red decimal 2 at the opening row
notes.text: A red decimal 2 precedes the first black runes at the top of the text panel. It continues the numbered list begun on LP1-10; the known reading associates this item with obtaining resources by luck and fearing future inability.
